name: smart-canteen
description: Smart Canteen Management System — web, mobile, admin, payments, realtime orders

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix web && npm install --prefix mobile
scripts.setup: npm run prisma:generate --prefix server && npm run prisma:push --prefix server && npm run seed --prefix server
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix web"
